items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I played with Jim Harrison's band there

ctx.x: Right. I met him in Cincinnati and he was playing on the band there so he came to Buffalo and he sent for me to come to Buffalo, New York so I played there for about a little over a year. I played with Jim Harrison's band there, a piano player and Eugene Promise MN.
Yeah. No, not the trombone player. No, lots of people get it mixed up. No, he played piano. But there was,
